# Getting help

- **How do I use it?** Start with the [README](https://github.com/KshRaven/runlytics#readme).
- **Something is broken.** [Open a bug report](https://github.com/KshRaven/runlytics/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with your version, Python version and a way to reproduce it.
- **I need a feature.** [Open a feature request](https://github.com/KshRaven/runlytics/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) and describe the problem you want solved.
- **Security.** Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/KshRaven/runlytics/security/advisories/new).
